title: SIDESTORY: WHO IS REAL RERUN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: WHO IS REAL RERUN
EVENT DURATION: July 14, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – July 28, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Who Is Real event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from the event shop.
EVENT STAGES DURATION:
Event Stages Duration: July 14, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – July 24, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[ASK YOURSELF]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Ask Yourself] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Lava the Purgatory, Tan-Ch'ing Court Furniture (Pieces), Dusk Inksticks.
[ANSWER YOURSELF]
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Dusk Inksticks by clearing event stages and Ask Yourself missions. Dusk Inksticks can be used to redeem items from Answer Yourself.
MAIN REWARDS: Lava the Purgatory's Token, Tan-Ch'ing Court Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Battle Record, Elite Materials, etc.
NOTE:
The requirements to obtain certain medals of this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted
requirements will receive the corresponding medals once log in.
Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Exchange Info] for more details.
[Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
Operators Dusk, Saga, Mr.Nothing, and Lava the Purgatory will gain more trust during the event rerun.
After the event rerun ends, this event will be archived into [Side Story] and become permanently available.

05 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – CELEBRATE & RECOLLECT

DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Celebrate & Recollect", opens and the first 6-star Operator obtained is guaranteed to be an unowned 6-star Operator from the following available Operators: Ch'en, Blaze, Exusiai, Siege, Ifrit, Hoshiguma, Shining, SilverAsh, Nightingale, Eyjafjalla, Hellagur, Saria, Mostima, Bagpipe, Aak, Magallan, Phantom, Skadi, Angelina, Schwarz, Ceobe, Weedy, Rosa, Suzuran, Thorns, Eunectes, Surtr, Blemishine, Mudrock, Mountain.
NOTE:
[Celebrate & Recollect] is part of the [Special Headhunting] headhunting series.
[Celebrate & Recollect] contains all 6*, 5* and 4* Operators in all the Standard Headhunting from the launch of the game to [Jail Tiger Unchained].
[SPECIAL HEADHUNTING] DETAILS:

- During [Special Headhunting] banners, the first 6-star Operator obtained is guaranteed to be an unowned 6-star Operator from the list of available Operators. If all available 6-star Operators are already owned, the first 6-star Operator obtained will be a random 6-star Operator from the list of available Operators.

- During [Special Headhunting] banners, if you do not get a 6-star Operator after 50 rolls, the probability of obtaining a 6-star Operator on the next roll will be increased from 2% to 4%. If you still do not roll a 6-star Operator, the probability of obtaining a 6-star Operator on the next roll will be further increased from 4% to 6%, and this process repeats until a maximum probability of 100%, at which point you are guaranteed to receive a 6-star Operator.

- The cumulative number of rolls that count towards this system will not carry over between different [Special Headhunting] banners, and this number will be reset at the end of each [Special Headhunting] banner. The increased probability of obtaining a 6-star Operator will also not be applied to any subsequent [Special Headhunting] banners.

- During [Special Headhunting] banners, the number of rolls without obtaining a 6-star Operator will not be accumulated or applied to any other banner, and will remain separate from any accumulated rolls on other banners.
NOTE:

Any time you obtain a 6-star Operator during a [Special Headhunting] banner, the next time you roll on that same [Special Headhunting] banner, the probability of obtaining a 6-star Operator will be reset to 2%.
